title: A direct proof of the complete Crouzeix inequality
summary: We give a direct proof of the sharp constant-two numerical-range inequality for matrix-valued polynomials in all finite base and coefficient dimensions. This resolves the complete Crouzeix conjecture in its matrix formulation, including matrices whose numerical ranges are points or line segments.

review.reason: Gives a direct proof of the complete Crouzeix inequality for matrix-valued polynomials.
